# SaltWatch Card 0.6.1

This documentation refresh replaces the old graphical-editor screenshot with
the real **Other device** entity-mapping workflow introduced in 0.6.0.

## What changed

- Updated the README and HACS description with the current editor UI.
- Showed the **Data source** selector and the primary entity-mapping fields.
- Added a clean, rounded presentation frame with even padding and a subtle
  shadow.
- Preserved the previous documentation image size of 1612 x 975 pixels.

There are no card behavior or configuration changes in this patch release.
